about: Gas handling accessories include hoses, fittings, flashback arrestors, trolleys, cylinder caps and safety chains. Using the right accessories keeps a gas set-up leak-free and safe.
Replace hoses that are cracked or worn, use flashback arrestors on fuel-gas lines and always secure cylinders upright. Tell us your gas and set-up and we can suggest the right accessories.
